name: P-84 (Atapu 2)
description: 225,000 bopd; 10 million Sm3/d gas; all-electric; 20% local content; Atapu consortium Petrobras 65.7%, Shell 16.7%, TotalEnergies 15%.

milestones.event: Petrobras awarded Seatrium newbuild supply contracts for P-84 and P-85
Saipem awarded three Kaminho contracts by TotalEnergies EP Angola Block 20
EMA recorded three FPSO orders since Q2 2024 totalling US$12.0Bn

capex.metric: FPSO newbuild EPC contract value, P-84 + P-85 combined (contractor's own statement)
capex.basis: Seatrium press release PDF: contracts valued at approximately S$11 billion; Singapore dollars preserved as printed, no conversion applied.

capex.metric: FPSO newbuild EPC contract value, P-84 + P-85 combined (press conversion)
capex.basis: NS Energy: contract worth S$11bn ($8.15bn) for two FPSOs; dollar figure as printed by the source.

capex.metric: FPSO newbuild EPC contract value, P-84 + P-85 combined (SPE JPT)
capex.basis: JPT: Petrobras awarded Seatrium an $8.16-billion contract to build two all-electric FPSOs; note conflict with 8.15 and 8.2 figures, not reconciled.

capex.metric: FPSO newbuild EPC contract value, P-84 + P-85 combined (EMA via Riviera)
capex.basis: Riviera/EMA: US$8.2Bn EPC award to Seatrium for P84 and P85; retained alongside conflicting 8.15/8.16 figures.

capex.metric: Indicative per-unit newbuild FPSO price, P-84/P-85 class
capex.basis: EMA managing director quoted in Riviera: most expensive FPSOs ever ordered 'at over US$4.0Bn' each; lower bound only, no exact figure stated.

capex.metric: Kaminho combined EPSCC FPSO + 12-year O&M + SURF contract value
capex.basis: Saipem press release: overall amount of the three contracts is 3.7 billion USD; explicitly a bundled scope, not a standalone FPSO unit cost.

capex.metric: Three FPSO orders placed since Q2 2024, aggregate
capex.basis: EMA Floating Production Systems report as quoted by Riviera: three units ordered since Q2 2024 totalling US$12.0Bn.

capex.metric: Floating production system share of 2024 offshore EPC awards
capex.basis: Westwood: FPS market accounted for 44% (US$23 billion) of offshore EPC contract awards in 2024; aggregate market figure, not a unit cost.

sources.note: 225,000 bopd; 10 million Sm3/d gas; all-electric; 20% local content; Atapu conso

gaps.what: Standalone P-84 and P-85 per-unit breakdown
gaps.why: All sources give only the combined contract value; EMA's over-US$4bn is an imprecise lower bound.
gaps.next_action: Seek Petrobras tender documentation or Seatrium annual report segment disclosure splitting P-84 and P-85.

gaps.why: Saipem's 3.7 billion USD bundles FPSO EPCC, 12-year O&M and SURF.
gaps.next_action: Look for Saipem order-intake disclosure or Angolan regulatory filing with a scope split.
